description: MUTATES Text-Em-All data: adds a new user to your account (a master user can do this). Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/account/users. Provide the user's fields via `fields` using the API's PascalCase names (e.g. UserName, FirstName, LastName, EmailAddress, Permissions). Returns the created user.

fields.description: Additional documented Text-Em-All fields to send verbatim in the JSON write body, using the API's PascalCase names (e.g. CallerID, TextNumberID, Lists, RetryTimes). Merged OVER the typed fields above.

name: add_account_user
title: Add an account user
